sentences.en: However, it is good if one can speak English well.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果能说好英语那就很好。

sentences.en: However you do it, the result will be the same.
sentences.zh: 不管你怎么做，结果都一样。

sentences.en: However busy you may be, you must do your homework.
sentences.zh: 无论你有多忙，你都必须完成作业。

senses.zh: 不管到什么程度, 无论如何然而, 可是, 不过
